ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 90% of the visible surface; low-intensity black is confined to the peripheral trailing edges and the inferior peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous high-intensity white region; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous narrow band along the trailing edge and a broader region at the base. Fine-scale dark mottling (pixel clusters) is localized near the interior trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth corresponds to roughly 12% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing boundary; characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 6 pixels, most prominent on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in sharp, acute-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of heterogeneous, high-contrast circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe; secondary sparse dark clusters located on the right lobe posterior surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on the right fluke tip; distinct dark pigmentation mask at the peduncle-fluke interface.
